channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: UN fact-finding mission says US committed possible war crimes in Iran
item.description: The mission also said Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during their crackdown on recent protests.

item.title: Five killed as Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthis trade attacks
item.description: Houthi leader Abdel-Malik al-Houthi says Saudi claims that the group targeted Mecca are a 'heinous lie'.

item.title: Ninth woman’s body found as South Africa probes series of killings
item.description: All female victims in their 20s and 30s were killed on the outskirts of Johannesburg in the past two months.

item.title: What are all the sanctions Iran is under?
item.description: Iran has faced a torrent of international sanctions since the 1979 revolution - here's what's in place right now.

item.title: Ghalibaf’s maths missile at Trump decoded: Is Iran fixing US interest rates?
item.description: Iran's speaker mocks US interest rates, citing the Taylor equation amidst rising global oil prices and inflation.

item.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
item.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

item.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
item.description: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.

item.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
item.description: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

item.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
item.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".
